sealed.data: every file under data/ whose name ends in .ndjson
sealed.meta: data/meta.json with its digest key removed, re-serialised as canonical JSON
sealed.rule: one line per sealed file, SHA-256 hex then two spaces then the relative path; lines sorted by bytes; the digest is the SHA-256 of the sorted lines

state: The House index layer and the first document layer. 441 seats of the 119th Congress, 439 of them filled and 2 vacant; 1,097 filings attributed to 393 sitting members from the Clerk 2025 filing index, retrieved 2026-09-22; 1,842 index rows rejected with a reason, the great majority of them candidates, who are out of scope per SUBJECTS.md section 3. Of the 417 transaction reports the index lists for sitting members, 363 were read from the Clerk's documents, retrieved 2026-09-23, and 6,242 transactions written, each checked against the seat and Filing ID printed in its report; 54 are scanned paper filings the register captured, hashed and does not read; 3 of the 363 print a seat other than the roster's and carry that discrepancy on the row. Annual reports are not yet read. No holdings and no Findings: no Signal definition has yet been run, and the transactions are shown on no page pending the Council's reading of that surface. 46 sitting members have no filing attributed and 255 rejected rows carry a surname matching exactly one sitting member whose given names differ. Those gaps are counted, not hidden. Presence in this register is not evidence of wrongdoing.
